title: CustomCosmetics - Build your own style!
body:
CustomCosmetics
    Build and wear your own unique style!​
Have you ever wanted to wear a tiny version of your house on your head? Or a cool pixel-art sword on your back? With CustomCosmetics, your imagination is the only limit!


Build Anything You Want: Enter a special 16x16x16 area and build your cosmetic with creative mode.
3 Cosmetic Slots: Wear your creations on your head, shoulder, or back.
Pixel-Art Scale: Your creations are automatically scaled down to a cool pixel-art size (1 block = 1 pixel).
Easy-to-Use GUI: Manage your equipped cosmetics with a simple and intuitive inventory.
Persistent Cosmetics: Your equipped cosmetics are saved when you log out and automatically re-equipped when you join back.
Lightweight & Optimized: Uses modern Display Entities for minimal server impact, ensuring smooth performance.
Permissions Support: Full support for permissions plugins like LuckPerms.


Commands:

/cc create <name> <type> - Starts the creation process.
Permission: customcosmetics.create
/cc accept - Finishes building and creates the cosmetic item.
Permission: customcosmetics.create
/cc inv - Opens the cosmetic inventory.
Permission: customcosmetics.inv
/cc reload - Reloads cosmetic definitions from files.
Permission: customcosmetics.admin
Permissions:
customcosmetics.create - Allows creating cosmetics. (Default: true)
customcosmetics.inv - Allows using the cosmetic inventory. (Default: true)
customcosmetics.admin - Allows using admin commands. (Default: op)
